fields.statement: Verifier at 7742d897c: go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/(render-refuses-damaged-log|log-entries-read-only|render)$ passes; the new script makes all three damages in turn, asserts render exits non-zero with the problem, diffs .rhiza/rendered unchanged each time, and a restored log renders again. By hand with a scratch build: on committed entries, a non-canonical rewrite and one entry's bytes under another's name each fail render naming the path with 'not canonical' / 'id or change set does not match its path' (plus 'differs from HEAD'), and a canonical sed edit fails with 'differs from HEAD'; on uncommitted entries (no HEAD diff) the non-canonical and ID-mismatch damages still fail with path and problem, so each check stands alone; .rhiza/rendered stayed unchanged and a clean log rendered (exit 0). internal/store passes; internal/api render/log/read-only tests (39) pass. The full internal/api package did not finish on the overloaded host (load 18 on 4 cores; TestReadBudget timed out), and rootguard flags the known usage.live.json leak into ~/code/.rhiza-root, unrelated to this diff. Nit: the script's cases 1 and 2 assert the problem text but not the path; case 3 asserts the path.
